metadata.question: Did Lake Menindee, Australia shrink from January 27, 2017 to February 2, 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking if Lake Menindee in Australia shrunk between January 27, 2017 and February 2, 2019. To answer this, I need to: 1. Find a way to measure water extent in the lake at both time points 2. Compare the water area/extent between the two dates 3. Use appropriate satellite data (Sentinel-2 would be good for water detection) 4. Handle cloud masking since clouds can interfere with water detection 5. Account for potential data availability issues I'll use the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) to detect water: NDWI = (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) Water typically has positive NDWI values. For Sentinel-2: - Green: B3 - NIR: B8 I'll create a polygon around Lake Menindee and calculate water area for both time periods, then compare. Let me structure this: 1. Define geometry for Lake Menindee area 2. Get Sentinel-2 imagery for both time periods (with some buffer around the exact dates) 3. Apply cloud masking 4. Calculate NDWI and create water masks 5. Count water pixels in each period 6. Compare and determine if there was shrinkage ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeMenindee = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [142.2, -32.35], [142.5, -32.35], [142.5, -32.45], [142.2, -32.45], [142.2, -32.35] ]); const date1_start = '2017-01-20'; const date1_end = '2017-02-03'; const date2_start = '2019-01-25'; const date2_end = '2019-02-09'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 function getWaterCollection(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeMenindee) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)); } const col1 = getWaterCollection(date1_start, date1_end); const col2 = getWaterCollection(date2_start, date2_end); // Check if collections are empty const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log(`2017 Images: ${size1}, 2019 Images: ${size2}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get median composites for each period const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); // Function to calculate water area function calculateWaterArea(img) { // Calculate NDWI const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Create water mask (NDWI > 0.0 indicates water) const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.0); // Count water pixels const waterCount = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeMenindee, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI'); return waterCount; } // Calculate water areas const waterArea1 = calculateWaterArea(img1); const waterArea2 = calculateWaterArea(img2); // Get the values const area1 = waterArea1.getInfo(); const area2 = waterArea2.getInfo(); // Check for no valid pixels if (area1 === 0 || area2 === 0) { console.log(`Water pixels 2017: ${area1}, 2019: ${area2}`); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (area1 === null || area2 === null || isNaN(area1) || isNaN(area2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Print results and determine answer const shrinkagePercent = ((area1 - area2) / area1 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`2017 Water pixels: ${area1.toFixed(0)}`); console.log(`2019 Water pixels: ${area2.toFixed(0)}`); console.log(`Change: ${shrinkagePercent}%`); // Determine if lake shrank (threshold: >5% decrease) if (area2 < area1 * 0.95) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
